methods_inherited.inherit: Measure the information floor PER ORGAN, never per model.
Judge a candidate on held-out REAL activations, never on weight-space error and never on synthetic or Gaussian activations.
Never evaluate a representation with an incompetent kernel. Fewer stored bits is not fewer nanoseconds.
Compute head cosine (and channel deadness, and layer near-identity) BEFORE proposing structural elimination.
When a body is fast and injured, measure how BROAD the injury is before spending on healing.
